title: Simple and effective
body:
I have only recently become an iOS user, and was struggling to find a simple habit tracker. Stumbled upon this and i must say, I couldn’t have been happier. It covers the basics and makes the habit tracking so easy. 
One suggestion would be to allow us to add our friends to a particular habit and track it with them, like a “Habit with your buddy” feature to build accountability.

title: Add Streaks
body:
Downgrading to three stars, as no updates or response from the developer.

I love this app and use it daily for my daily tracking. 

However, what I find missing is the streak - consecutive, non-stop days a habit is being complied with. Percentage doesn’t tell for how many days a habit is running. Thank you.

title: Used to be great, then they screwed over loyal users
body:
I’ve been a long time user of Habit and had even bought the premium IAP to unlock features like widget, themes and unlimited habits. 

But in a recent update, the app has switched to a subscription model, and features that were previously available to me because of the IAP are now locked and I’m being asked to subscribe to get them back. 

This is not cool. At least old users who had already bought the full feature set should be allowed to keep it. New users could be moved to a subscription model if the developer is so inclined. 

Really disappointed.

title: Efficient and minimalistic
body: This is the only habit tracker app out there that i find useful because of its simple and intuitive interface. I personally don’t prefer a whole bunch of features as I feel like I wind up wasting a lot of time just exploring all the menus, which kind of defies the whole purpose of an app like this. I won’t be using half the features down the line anyway. The developer has done a great job with this. The only thing it LACKS is an APP LOCKER. It’d be really helpful for the sake of privacy.

title: Extremely Customisable Everyday Tracker
body: Among so many trackers Habit seems to suit me the most. Its UI is great, works flawlessly on my Apple Watch and the ever-growing bubble which grows with task completion is a motivator in itself. The only place where this app lacks is not allowing adding same day tracker. Like for example, taking medicines. This activity may need to happen multiple times a day. Hence adding a functionality to do this will expand the user base much further
